name: rizzfizz
description: CLI-first design intelligence utility for scrubbed website-builder briefs and OKLCH palette tokens.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node bin/cli.js palette --relationship dark-sparse-accent --hue blue --variants 4 --out /tmp/rizzfizz-smoke-palette.json && node bin/cli.js export --format a-eyes-variant-tokens --input /tmp/rizzfizz-smoke-palette.json --out /tmp/rizzfizz-smoke-aeyes.json
